environment: Owned API35 Android emulator; authenticated synthetic fixture; provider audio routes blocked. No real private conversation screenshots.

checks.normalPortrait: single context surface above composer; complete synthetic answer readable; notes count visible; Reply/Go/Resume/Clear direct
checks.largeFont: font scale 2 preserves full-width context, scalable count reservation, 48dp playback targets, active keyboard and draft
checks.narrowPortrait: 360dp viewport keeps full-width context and a single action row inside the same surface
checks.deduplication: Exact normalized equivalent content shares context only for same known conversation; actual different-thread identical text remains separate; extra speech sentence remains visible
checks.draftAndPlayback: Reply appends original note context without sending or dropping existing draft; Resume/Clear keep active keyboard and full draft
checks.notesNavigation: Go to message reaches synthetic original transcript row
checks.notesRemoval: Expanded-note Remove sends authenticated request; failed request restores note with visible error; retry returns acknowledged empty notes; persistent speech captions remain independently available
checks.notesExpansion: Visible count/chevron opens all retained notes
checks.immersion: Direct phrase tap replaces Italian phrase in place without opening retained-notes panel
checks.coordinator: One compact mic beside typed editor; no redundant Keyboard control/full-width mic row; actual Enter submission authenticated once; response rendered after normal polling and prior history retained

limits: Synthetic qualification does not establish physical phone installation or real-provider voice quality.
Narrow/large-font screens deliberately place one action row beneath full-width text inside the same surface for legibility.
Secondary Remove remains in the existing expanded notes panel; Reply and source navigation are directly available.
Clear/dismiss controls use readable native glyphs because authored equivalents are not currently present; no new CGI render was started.
Unknown speech source identity is kept separate rather than inferred from matching words.
